newsitem.title: USA: Mar/Apr WTI crude inches wider in U.S. cash trade.
newsitem.headline: Mar/Apr WTI crude inches wider in U.S. cash trade.

text.p: U.S. cash crude markets headed to next week's March pipeline scheduling deadline focused on a widening March/April West Texas Intermediate/Cushing spread.
Traders said the Friday session has seen the Mar/Apr roll trade at 34 cents, around 5 cts higher than late Thursday, and currently was valued either side of the 32-33 cts level.
Mar Postings-Plus activity highlighted a rather quiet morning, selling at $2.10 and $2.11. Domestic grades were discussed at mostly steady levels from late Thursday.
Currently, March WTI/Cushing was seen at $21.70-80 a barrel, while April WTI/Cushing was 25 cts lower at $21.40-50.
